free_tier.stated: 10 MB per document by default (sizelimit = 10000000 in upstream conf.sample.php); ~30+ listed public instances, some with file upload enabled. No account, no quota.

egress.terms: free, direct from each instance; most are Cloudflare-proxied (the directory lists CSP/Observatory ratings and uptime).

tooling: Encrypted JSON POST to the instance root with X-Requested-With: JSONHttpRequest; official JS client plus community CLIs. github.com/PrivateBin/PrivateBin (8690 stars). Instances are independently operated.
chaining: N instances x 10 MB, and each instance is a separate operator with separate rate policy — so this is the one pastebin class where horizontal sharding across operators is native. Still only ~50 instances, so the aggregate is single-digit GB per round.
limits_note: 10 MB per paste by default (per-instance override); file upload is disabled by default (fileupload = false) and about half the directory shows no file-upload support; burn-after-reading and expiry are server-configurable.
